info.title: TOPEMS API
info.description:
TOPEMS 企业级 SaaS 平台统一 API 文档（由 aggregate.py 从 cargo test 提取的 spec 聚合生成）

聚合自 30 个服务，共 1915 个端点、477 个 Schema（含 206 个标准类型）。
生成时间: 2026-08-10T05:18:57.460826+00:00

post.description:
Triggers a synchronous execution of the comparison. The result is
persisted in `analytics_comparison_results` and the parent record is
updated to `completed` with a fresh `last_run_at` timestamp.

get.summary: List datasources with optional pagination and filtering.
Get a single datasource by id.

post.summary: Trigger a manual refresh/sync for a datasource.
post.description:
Updates `last_sync`, increments `data_volume` (heuristic based on type)
and marks the datasource as `active` on success.

post.summary: Test the connection for a datasource.
post.description:
Performs a lightweight validation: ensures the record exists, is enabled,
and contains the minimum required connection parameters. For built-in
`postgresql`/`postgres` types it issues a `SELECT 1` via a short-lived
sqlx pool; for other types it reports `success` based on the presence of
host/port/database/connection_string so the UI can mark the result
accordingly.

get.description: 看板总览：聚合返回 summary、订单进度、工位状态、质量趋势、设备状态。
设备状态：每台设备关联最新 OEE 记录。
订单进度列表：progress = completed_quantity / quantity * 100
质量趋势：按天聚合 quality_records，计算合格率与数量。
工位状态：每台工位关联当前在制生产记录及当日产出。
